{{Current events|year=2020|month=03|day=19|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->

;Arts and culture
*[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**[[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on television]]
***Actor [[Daniel Dae Kim]] tests positive for [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/19/entertainment/daniel-dae-kim-coronavirus/index.html (CNN)]
*The wreckage of the [[USS Stickleback (SS-415)|USS Stickleback]] is discovered on the [[Hawaiian Islands|Hawaii Island]] of [[Oahu]]. [https://www.livescience.com/cold-war-submarine-wreck-hawaii-coast.html (Live Science)]

;Business and economy
*[[Socio-economic impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]], [[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States]]
**[[Domino's Pizza]] is expected to hire 10,000 delivery drivers in response to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. Due to the pandemic, numerous government officials have banned restaurant customers from using dining rooms. [https://thehill.com/blogs/blog-briefing-room/news/488473-dominos-to-hire-10000-new-employees-in-response-to-coronavirus (''The Hill'')]
**[[Jet's Pizza]] is hiring hundreds of employees for its delivery service in 20 states to keep up with demand during the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.mlive.com/coronavirus/2020/03/jets-pizza-hiring-hundreds-to-keep-up-with-demand-during-coronavirus-pandemic.html (MLive)]
**[[Meijer]], whose stores are usually open 24 hours, announces it will decrease its business hours to 8am–10pm local time starting tomorrow to allow for cleaning and restocking. [https://www.mlive.com/coronavirus/2020/03/meijer-to-drop-24-hour-service-amid-coronavirus-pandemic.html (MLive)]
**[[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]] [[Republican Party (United States)|Republicans]] unveil a $1 trillion economic stimulus package proposal to aid businesses and the American public during the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/19/politics/coronavirus-economic-stimulus-senate-republicans/index.html (CNN)]

;Health and environment
*[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Europe]]
***The [[European Union]]'s chief [[Brexit]] negotiator, [[Michel Barnier]], tests positive for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-eus-brexit-negotiator-michel-barnier-tests-positive-for-covid-19-11960128 (Sky News)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Italy]]
****In [[Italy]], the military is deployed to the city of [[Bergamo]], [[Lombardy]], the Italian city worst hit by [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], to collect and transport the bodies of dead residents to [[crematorium]]s in other cities, as Bergamo’s authorities say their facilities can no longer process the large number of fatalities. The city's mayor [[Giorgio Gori]] says the true number of dead could be much higher than what's been reported.  [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-italian-army-called-in-to-carry-away-corpses-as-citys-crematorium-is-overwhelmed-11959994 (Sky News)]
****The number of confirmed [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] deaths in Italy overtakes the number in China, as 3,405 are now confirmed dead due to the virus. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-51955509 (BBC News)]
****Marcello Natali, a doctor from [[Italy]] known for exposing the country's chronic shortage of medical supplies, dies from the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]]. The Italian Federation of General Practitioners confirms his death. [https://nypost.com/2020/03/19/marcello-natali-italian-doctor-who-exposed-supply-shortage-dies-from-coronavirus/ (''New York Post'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[Northern Ireland]] confirms its first death from [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], an elderly man with an underlying medical condition who was being treated at a hospital in [[Greater Belfast]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-51958241 (BBC News)]
****The [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] death toll in the [[United Kingdom]] rises to 144. [https://www.itv.com/news/2020-03-19/number-coronavirus-deaths-cases-england-uk-rise-nhs-128/ (''ITV News'')]
****The British government introduces the [[Coronavirus Bill 2019–21]], which would grant it extensive discretionary emergency powers in managing the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-51964163 (BBC News)]
****The British government puts 20,000 [[British Army]] reservists on standby to help with the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-britain/uk-puts-military-on-standby-queen-addresses-anxious-nation-idUKKBN2160X7 (Reuters)]
****[[Transport for London]] announces the closure of 40 train stations, including [[London Waterloo station]] and the [[Hammersmith & City line]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2020/mar/19/london-tube-to-close-many-stations-because-of-coronavirus (''The Guardian'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Monaco]]
****[[Albert II, Prince of Monaco]], tests positive for [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], becoming the world's first [[head of state]] to test positive for the virus. [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/breaking-coronavirus-prince-albert-monaco-21720586 (''Daily Mirror'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]]'s [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Ministry of Health]] says the country’s [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] death toll has risen to 767, with 169 more deaths and 3,431 new confirmed cases, for a total of 17,147 cases. [https://gulfnews.com/world/europe/spain-coronavirus-death-toll-soars-to-767-1.70500890 (''Gulf News'')]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Asia]]
***[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic in Hubei]], [[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic in mainland China]]
****[[China]], in its daily [[National Health Commission]] report, lists no new domestic [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] cases for the first time since the coronavirus pandemic began in [[Wuhan]]. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/china-reports-no-new-domestic-coronavirus-cases-for-first-time-national-health-commission/articleshow/74703935.cms (''The Economic Times'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]]'s [[Ministry of Health and Medical Education]] reports 149 more [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] deaths and an additional 1,046 cases, bringing the death toll in the country to 1,284 and its total number of cases to 18,407. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-iran/irans-death-toll-from-coronavirus-rises-to-1284-idUSKBN2161O4 (Reuters)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Australia]]
****[[Australia]] closes its borders to all non-Australian residents. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-australia/australia-closes-borders-to-coronavirus-pumps-56-billion-into-economy-idUSKBN2160JJ?il=0 (Reuters)]
****[[Australia|Australian]] [[Prime Minister of Australia|Prime Minister]] [[Scott Morrison]] says about A$100 billion will be injected into the [[Economy of Australia|Australian economy]] to support it during the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/australia-economy-to-get-a-dollar56-billion-coronavirus-protection-injection/ar-BB11ookf (MSN)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Fiji]]
****[[Fiji]] reports its first confirmed case of [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], a male patient in [[Lautoka]]. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/news/article.cfm?c_id=2&objectid=12318204 (''The New Zealand Herald'')]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Russia]]
***[[Russia]] reports its first death from [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [[Moscow]] city authorities say the victim was a 79-year-old woman with underlying health conditions. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-russia-death/first-coronavirus-death-reported-in-russia-which-plans-to-quarantine-all-new-arrivals-idUSKBN21615H?il=0 (Reuters)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in North America]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States]]
****The number of [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] cases in the [[United States]] surpasses 10,000, with 13,229 confirmed cases. The death toll stands at 195. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/03/health/us-coronavirus-cases-state-by-state/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.wsj.com/articles/china-reports-no-new-domestic-coronavirus-infections-for-the-first-time-since-outbreak-started-11584611233 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
****The [[United States State Department|U.S. State Department]] warns American citizens not to travel abroad due to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/19/politics/state-department-travel-advisory/index.html?utm_term=1584648603477837c7fd86089&utm_source=Breaking+News&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=155001&bt_ee=kXywcRzipNYLMfUaVOBmL9RvLrnkrXsVE0JWUcPSSrptWyteZB3STUZSnhb4MaWQ&bt_ts=1584648603494 (CNN)]
****[[Sean Payton]], the head coach of the [[New Orleans Saints]], says he has tested positive for [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://nypost.com/2020/03/19/saints-coach-sean-payton-tests-positive-for-coronavirus/ (''New York Post'')]
****[[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on education]]
*****While educational facilities close across the [[United States]] due to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]], the [[United States Department of Education|U.S. Department of Education]] tells educators that [[educational technology|online learning]] must comply with [[civil and political rights|civil rights]] laws, including making sure learning tools are available to students. However, as not every student has access to the [[internet]], many students will be unable to participate, prompting some public school systems to implement "enrichment" policies. Under these policies, [[coursework]] completed under [[educational technology|online learning]] will not officially count towards advancing to the next [[academic term]]. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/schools-closed-for-coronavirus-online-work-wont-count-11584643049 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in California]]
*****Six counties in the [[San Francisco Bay Area]] announce [[shelter in place]] orders for all residents due to the ongoing [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.sfchronicle.com/local-politics/amp/Bay-Area-must-shelter-in-place-Only-15135014.php (''San Francisco Chronicle'')]
*****[[Los Angeles County]], [[California]], announces a near-lockdown, urging residents to stay in their homes and to only go out in public for essential needs. [https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/news/california/story/2020-03-19/los-angeles-county-announces-near-lockdown-all-residents-urged-to-stay-home-except-for-essential-needs?_amp=true& (''The San Diego Union-Tribune'')]
*****[[Governor of California|California Governor]] [[Gavin Newsom]] issues a statewide stay-at-home order for all Californians except for essential errands such as grocery shopping or for medical services. [http://www.pbs.org/newshour/amp/nation/california-governor-issues-stay-at-home-order-amid-coronavirus-outbreak (''PBS NewsHour'')]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Michigan]]
*****Two more people die from [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] in [[Michigan]] and the total number of cases in the state rises to 334. The two fatalities are identified as an 81-year-old and a woman in her 50s with underlying health conditions. [https://www.mlive.com/public-interest/2020/03/two-more-coronavirus-deaths-reported-in-michigan.html (MLive)] [https://www.mlive.com/public-interest/2020/03/michigan-coronavirus-cases-jump-to-336-with-increase-of-private-testing.html (MLive<sub>2</sub>)]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Hawaii]]
*****[[Hawaii]] says that it will not allow the passengers of two cruise ships heading for its coast to disembark upon arrival due to the ongoing [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]], despite both ships reporting zero cases of [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/reported-coronavirus-hawaii-cruise-ship-passengers-disembark/story?id=69683821 (ABC News)]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in New York (state)|2020 coronavirus pandemic in New York]]
*****[[New York City]] [[Mayor of New York City|Mayor]] [[Bill de Blasio]] says the city's [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] death toll stands at 22, with 3,615 cases. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/03/19/new-york-city-has-3615-confirmed-coronavirus-cases-including-an-inmate-at-rikers-island-mayor-de-blasio-says.html (CNBC)]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Florida]]
*****[[Florida]] [[United States Senate|Senator]] [[Rick Scott]] urges those visiting the state for [[spring break]] to stay away from public beaches to avoid the spread of the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]]. [https://www.sun-sentinel.com/coronavirus/fl-ne-florida-beaches-coronavirus-20200319-45upiema4vdftanmkreuph7kk4-story.html (''Sun-Sentinel'')]
*****In an effort to prevent those visiting the state for [[spring break]] from gathering on beaches amid the ongoing [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]], [[Governor of Florida|Florida Governor]] [[Ron DeSantis]] institutes [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] guidelines preventing large crowds and says "the party’s over." However, he stops short of closing all public beaches in the state, despite calls for him to do so. [https://nypost.com/2020/03/19/florida-governor-says-partys-over-for-spring-breakers-amid-coronavirus-crisis/ (''New York Post'')]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Pennsylvania]]
*****[[List of governors of Pennsylvania|Pennsylvania Governor]] [[Tom Wolf]] orders all non-life-sustaining businesses in the state to close physical locations to slow the spread of the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]]. [https://www.wgal.com/article/all-non-life-sustaining-businesses-in-pennsylvania-ordered-to-close-physical-locations-to-stop-coronavirus-spread/31789626/ (WGAL)]
*****The first [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] death in [[Pennsylvania]] is reported, an adult from [[Northampton County, Pennsylvania | Northampton County]]. He was being treated at a hospital prior to his death. There were no specific details released on the patient or his health prior to contracting the virus. [https://www.wgal.com/article/wolf-administration-announces-pennsylvanias-first-death-related-to-coronavirus/31753649/ (WGAL)]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Georgia (U.S. state)]]
*****[[List of governors of Georgia|Georgia Governor]] [[Brian Kemp]] says he does not plan on ordering business to close or shutting down public events amid the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.news4jax.com/news/local/2020/03/19/gov-brian-kemp-to-address-covid-19-in-georgia/ (WJXT)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Mexico]]
****[[Mexico]] reports its first death from [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], a 41-year-old [[diabetes|diabetic]] man. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-mexico-tally/diabetic-man-becomes-mexicos-first-coronavirus-death-idUKKBN216058?il=0 (Reuters)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Haiti]]
****[[Haiti]] confirms its first two cases of [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.voanews.com/science-health/coronavirus-outbreak/haiti-confirms-its-first-coronavirus-cases (Voice of America)]
****Amid the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]], [[Haiti]] declares a [[state of emergency]]. All schools, universities, industrial parks and airports will be closed from midnight, while a nationwide [[curfew]] will be in force from 8pm to 5am. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-haiti/haiti-declares-emergency-over-coronavirus-imposes-curfew-shuts-border-idUSKBN21700V (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Syria–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] calls for the [[Syrian government]] to release journalist and veteran [[United States Marine Corps|Marine]] [[Austin Tice]], arguing the "U.S. has done a lot for [[Syria]]". [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-calls-on-syria-to-release-journalist-austin-tice/ (CBS News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representative]] from [[Hawaii]] [[Tulsi Gabbard]] ends her [[Tulsi Gabbard 2020 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]] in the [[2020 United States presidential election|2020 presidential election]] and endorses former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/03/19/politics/tulsi-gabbard-ends-2020-campaign/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2020 Vanuatuan general election]]
**Registered voters in [[Vanuatu]] head to the polls to elect members of [[Parliament of Vanuatu|parliament]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/412135/vanuatu-goes-to-the-polls (Radio New Zealand)]

;Sports
*[[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on sports]]
**The suspension of [[association football|football]] games in [[England]], including the [[Premier League]] and [[English Football League]], is extended until at least April 30 due to the continued spread of the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/51962751 (BBC News)]
**[[2020 Summer Olympics torch relay]]
***Despite calls for the cancelation of the [[2020 Summer Olympics]] due to the ongoing [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]], [[Greece]] hands the [[Olympic flame]] over to [[Japan]] in a ceremony without spectators. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2020/03/074aa7d2295f-olympic-flame-to-be-handed-over-to-japan-amid-coronavirus-fears.html (Kyodo News Plus)]
**[[2019–20 NBA season]]
***Three people employed by the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] test positive for [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.inquirer.com/health/coronavirus/three-members-sixers-organization-test-positive-covid-19-20200319.html (''The Philadelphia Inquirer'')]
*The [[Los Angeles Rams]] release running back [[Todd Gurley]] from the team hours before a contract stipulation that would have required the Rams to pay Gurley $10.5 million goes into effect. [https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/rams-release-running-back-todd-gurley-just-prior-to-deadline-for-eight-figure-roster-bonus/ (CBS Sports)]
*The [[Boston Red Sox]] announce that [[pitcher]] [[Chris Sale]] will be undergoing [[ulnar collateral ligament reconstruction]]. As a result, Sale will miss the entire [[2020 Boston Red Sox season]]. [https://sports.yahoo.com/red-sox-ace-chris-sale-will-undergo-tommy-john-surgery-210444741.html (Yahoo Sports)]
